content.short: Payment platform built for aid organisations to move funds into hard-to-reach places in minutes.
content.description: Coala Pay helps humanitarian groups and donors send institutional funds into corridors where banking is slow or broken, settling in minutes instead of weeks so less value is lost on the way. Its milestone-based model releases money as goals are met, and compliance tools track every disbursement. It reports a 100% delivery record in every corridor it has served since 2023.
content.meta: Coala Pay settles humanitarian aid in minutes using stablecoins, with milestone-based releases and full compliance tracking.
